account.title: Which account?
account.intro: amo reads your deals and their clients from one amoCRM or Kommo account, and changes them only with your permission.
account.host.hint: The address you open the CRM at: https://<subdomain>.amocrm.ru, or https://<subdomain>.kommo.com for Kommo.
integration.title: Create a private integration
integration.amocrm:
An account administrator does this once, in amoCRM:

1. Open **амоМаркет**, click **⋯** at the top left and choose **«Создать интеграцию»**.
2. Give it a name and a description, such as *WireCat*.
3. As the Redirect URI, enter `https://wirecat.dev/webhooks/apps/amo-callback`. The token does not use it, but the same integration then also works for a browser sign-in later.
4. Tick **«Доступ к данным аккаунта»** and save.

amoCRM's guide: https://www.amocrm.ru/developers/content/oauth/step-by-step
integration.waiver: On most accounts amoCRM first asks you to sign a waiver of technical support for private integrations. amoCRM says it cannot be taken back. Read it before you sign: https://www.amocrm.ru/developers/content/integrations/intro
integration.kommo.title: On Kommo
integration.kommo: Settings → Integrations → **Create integration**, a private one. Use the same Redirect URI, then open its **Keys and scopes** tab.
token.title: Make the token
token.where: In the integration, open the **«Ключи»** tab (Kommo: **Keys and scopes**) and click **«Сгенерировать токен»**. Pick an end date, from one day to five years, and copy the token: it is shown only once.
token.label: Long-lived token
token.hint: Kept in your system keyring, never in a file in plain text.
token.rights: The token acts with the rights of the administrator who made it. amo stops agents' changes with its permissions: `amo <profile> config set permissions …`.
check.title: Checking the token
check.body: amo asks the account who the token belongs to. It saves the address and the token only if the account answers.
failed.title: The account did not answer
failed.body: amo could not reach the account, so nothing was saved. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
